verdict.rationale: Official docs show the Angular CLI can run unit tests and end-to-end tests ('ng test', 'ng e2e'). Community comments describe Angular as built for testability with comprehensive test support. Nothing in the evidence describes utilities for rendering a component in isolation and interacting with it. Missing for 10: documented component-testing utilities (rendering a component in isolation, querying or interacting with its DOM, triggering change detection), in-depth testing docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of component-level testing.
